rows.label: Keir Starmer
rows.description: Prime Minister of the United Kingdom from 2024 to 2026
rows.hook: was a human-rights barrister and the head of public prosecutions before entering politics

rows.label: Margaret Thatcher
rows.description: Prime Minister of the United Kingdom from 1979 to 1990
rows.hook: became the first woman to hold the office and earned the nickname the Iron Lady

rows.hook: worked in finance for an investment bank and hedge funds before entering politics

rows.label: Boris Johnson
rows.description: Prime Minister of the United Kingdom from 2019 to 2022

rows.label: Tony Blair
rows.description: Prime Minister of the United Kingdom from 1997 to 2007
rows.hook: won three general elections in a row, a feat no other leader on his side has matched

rows.label: Liz Truss
rows.description: Prime Minister of the United Kingdom in 2022
rows.hook: holds the record for the shortest time in the job, lasting under two months

rows.label: Harold Wilson

rows.hook: won four general elections, more than any other leader on his side

rows.label: David Cameron
